page.title: Partners
page.description: Invite a new partner with a setup link, or assign an organization you already work with. Each partnership connects one hosted project with one partner.

guide.title: How partnering works
guide.inviteText: Send a setup link to a new partner, or assign an organization you already work with.
guide.joinText: They confirm with the invited email address. Each link is single-use and expires after 7 days.
guide.collaborateText: The partnership appears under the Partnerships tab, ready for participants and claims.
